description: Source code implementing the Bluetooth AVDTP (Audio Video Distribution Protocol) layer, including L2CAP communication, session management, and message handling.

methods.name: avdtp_send
methods.description: Sends an AVDTP signaling message over L2CAP and starts a timeout for the request.

methods.name: avdtp_create_pdu
methods.description: Creates a new AVDTP protocol data unit (PDU) with specified message type, packet type, and signal ID.

methods.name: avdtp_timeout
methods.description: Handles timeout events for AVDTP signaling requests.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_l2cap_connected
methods.description: Callback invoked when an L2CAP channel is connected, initializes session timer.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_l2cap_disconnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when an L2CAP channel is disconnected, cleans up session.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_l2cap_encrypt_changed
methods.description: Callback invoked when encryption status changes on the L2CAP channel.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_l2cap_recv
methods.description: Handles received data on the L2CAP channel, parses AVDTP signaling messages.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_connect
methods.description: Establishes an AVDTP signaling connection over L2CAP.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_l2cap_accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming L2CAP connection requests and initializes AVDTP session.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_register_sep
methods.description: Registers a Stream End Point (SEP) with specified media type and role.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_init
methods.description: Initializes the AVDTP subsystem and registers the L2CAP server.

methods.name: bt_avdtp_discover
methods.description: Sends a discover request to a remote AVDTP device.
